name: 🥢 Egg Roll in a Bowl
tagline: Everything good about an egg roll, none of the frying: 20 minutes in one skillet.

steps.text: Heat the oil in your biggest skillet over high. Add the chicken, press flat and leave it 4 minutes to brown hard, then crumble.
Push the meat aside. Add garlic, ginger and the white parts of the green onions; stir 30 seconds.
Stir together soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar and sesame oil.
Add the slaw and the sauce. Toss 2–3 minutes, just until wilted but still crunchy.
Mix the mayo with sriracha to taste (keep a plain bowl for milder eaters).
Serve over rice with green onion tops and a drizzle of spicy mayo.

kid_jobs.job: Stir up the spicy mayo (taste-test it!)
Slice green onions with kid scissors
Rinse the rice before it cooks

chef_tip: High heat and a short cook on the slaw: it should still crunch. Overcooked cabbage goes limp and watery.
make_ahead: Cook the rice ahead; this one is fast enough to make fresh.
leftovers: Holds well for lunch; or roll it in a tortilla with spicy mayo.
swaps: Cauliflower rice for a lighter bowl
serve_with: Over jasmine rice, or with crispy wonton strips on top

game_plan.what: Chicken in a hot skillet; leave it 4 min to brown.
Kids stir up the sauce and the spicy mayo.
Crumble the chicken; garlic, ginger and green onions in.
Slaw and sauce in; toss just until wilted.
Over rice with green onion tops and spicy mayo.
